name: world-rpg-producer
compatibility: Schema/session 1.0 retained; existing saves remain usable with their unchanged original game.json. Changed game data requires a new game or explicit migration; no automatic save rewrite.
runtime_features: actor-filtered memories and recent event recall
required_runtime: Python 3.10+ for collection/export/state tools; host AI performs semantic research/design

research.fallback_discovery: Wikipedia zh/en MediaWiki API; limited to encyclopedia candidates
research.collection: HTTP(S) text, txt/md/srt/vtt/epub/docx; PDF text only if pypdf already available
research.verification: AI must read sources and assess meaning, continuity and independence; scripts enforce structural gates

optional_dependencies: pypdf for local PDF text extraction
runtime_limitations: Pure chat requires manual save and external dice or explicitly labelled narrative rulings
SillyTavern exports do not install a model or an automatic MVU integration
No true secrecy isolation inside a shared model context or shared files
Format validation does not prove every client import or long-term gameplay quality
